01_list.title: List
01_list.use: Ordered, mutable collections; batches of rows; general-purpose buffer.
01_list.avoid: Frequent membership tests (use a set) or front insertions (use a deque).
01_list.de: Holding a batch of records before a bulk write; collecting rows from a paginated API.

02_tuple.title: Tuple
02_tuple.use: Fixed records and composite dictionary keys; safe to hash and share.
02_tuple.avoid: Data that must change in place.
02_tuple.de: Composite keys such as (customer_id, date); returning multiple values from a transform.

03_set.title: Set
03_set.use: Uniqueness and fast membership; set algebra.
03_set.de: Deduplicating IDs, finding new or missing keys between two loads.

04_dict.title: Dictionary
04_dict.use: Key to value lookups; counting; grouping; caching.
04_dict.avoid: Memory-tight workloads with huge numbers of small entries.
04_dict.de: Lookup tables for enrichment, group-by aggregation, schema mappings, JSON records.

05_stack.title: Stack
05_stack.use: LIFO problems: undo, parsing, balanced brackets, DFS.
05_stack.de: Validating nested JSON or expressions; iterative depth-first traversal of dependency graphs.

06_queue.title: Queue
06_queue.use: FIFO processing, BFS, buffering between producer and consumer.
06_queue.de: Models message queues (Pub/Sub, Kafka); task queues; BFS over lineage graphs.

07_singly_linked_list.title: Singly Linked List
07_singly_linked_list.use: Cheap head insertions; building blocks for stacks, queues, hash chaining.
07_singly_linked_list.de: Mostly an interview topic; underlies hash table chaining and LRU-style structures.

08_doubly_linked_list.title: Doubly Linked List
08_doubly_linked_list.use: Two-way traversal and O(1) removal of a known node.
08_doubly_linked_list.de: LRU caches (with a dict), browser-history style navigation, deque implementations.

09_circular_linked_list.title: Circular Linked List
09_circular_linked_list.avoid: When a clear end-of-list is needed and loops risk infinite iteration.

10_hash_table.title: Hash Table
10_hash_table.use: Fast key lookups; understand collision handling and load factor.
10_hash_table.de: Hash joins, hash partitioning and shuffles in Spark and BigQuery, deduplication.

11_binary_tree.title: Binary Tree
11_binary_tree.use: Hierarchical data; foundation for BST, heap, expression trees.
11_binary_tree.avoid: Searching by value when no ordering exists.
11_binary_tree.de: Nested JSON or org hierarchies; query plan and expression trees.

12_binary_search_tree.title: Binary Search Tree
12_binary_search_tree.use: Sorted data with dynamic inserts and range queries.
12_binary_search_tree.de: Concept behind ordered indexes and range scans.

13_avl_tree.title: AVL Tree
13_avl_tree.use: Ordered data where worst-case lookup time matters.
13_avl_tree.avoid: Write-heavy workloads where rotation cost dominates.
13_avl_tree.de: Background for balanced indexes (B-trees, red-black trees) in databases.

14_heap_priority_queue.title: Heap / Priority Queue
14_heap_priority_queue.use: Always get the smallest or largest item; top-K; scheduling.
14_heap_priority_queue.de: Top-K per group, merging sorted streams, priority-based task scheduling.

15_graph.title: Graph
15_graph.de: Pipeline DAGs (Airflow), data lineage, dependency resolution, topological sort.

16_trie.title: Trie
16_trie.use: Prefix lookups, autocomplete, dictionary matching (L = word length).
16_trie.avoid: Small key sets where a dict is simpler.
16_trie.de: Prefix matching of paths and IDs, autocomplete, routing tables.
